evals.prompt: Validate spec-to-pr and lite workflow paths.
check-workflows after editing STEP-DISPATCH — lite must not use standard-only table
assertions: Distinguishes spec-to-pr standard steps from lite steps 0–5
Reports critical findings with file paths
Uses path tokens ({skillsRoot}, {sharedDir}, {plansDir}) instead of hardcoded consumer paths

evals.prompt: check-workflows with autoMode ON — the orchestrator must be unattended
evals.expected_output: Validator confirms the canonical autoMode stop list and the internal-checkpoint no-yield rule.
assertions: Asserts gates.md § autoMode stop conditions lists only the valid stops (red suite, destructive confirm, missing credentials/network, terminal status)
Asserts both orch SKILLs reference that section without duplicating the stop list
Flags a missing internal-checkpoint no-yield clause as CRITICAL

evals.prompt: check-workflows with autoMode OFF — gates must wait for the user each step or per gateGranularity
evals.expected_output: Validator confirms normal-mode gating at the step boundary and the step|phase granularity.
assertions: Asserts defaults.gateGranularity is documented with step (user-gate at each step boundary) and phase (at most five blocking gates)
Asserts both orch SKILLs document normal-mode per-step-boundary gating
Flags an undocumented OFF-mode gate cadence as CRITICAL
